label: Precipitation
text: Only 0.7 mm today and it is all evening: 0.1 mm at 20:00, 0.4 mm at 21:00, 0.2 mm at 22:00, on 58–68% hourly probability. Tomorrow goes much wetter and then sharply colder — 1.6 mm, peak probability 73%, high 14.7 °C collapsing to −0.4 °C overnight, with 24 Nov holding dry at 2.5 °C / −3.7 °C.
